values.en: Fundamental Forms of a Sphere with Outward Normal
values.zh-CN: 球面外法向下的基本形式

values.en: Let $R>0$ and $\Omega=(0,\pi)\times(0,2\pi)$. The total smooth map $X(u,v)=R(\sin u\cos v,\sin u\sin v,\cos u)$ is regular on $\Omega$. There $X_u\times X_v=R\sin u\,X$, so its ordered-cross-product normal is outward: $\boldsymbol N=X/R$. Direct differentiation gives $E=R^2$, $F=0$, $G=R^2\sin^2u$ and $e=-R$, $f=0$, $g=-R\sin^2u$. Consequently $\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(q;w,z)=-(1/R)\mathrm I_X(q;w,z)$ for all $q\in\Omega$ and $w,z\in T_qX$. Equivalently, $d\boldsymbol N(w)=w/R$ in the surface notation, confirming the negative sign. The poles are excluded by the chart domain, not singular points of the sphere.
values.zh-CN: 取 $R>0$、$\Omega=(0,\pi)\times(0,2\pi)$。全空间光滑映射 $X(u,v)=R(\sin u\cos v,\sin u\sin v,\cos u)$ 在 $\Omega$ 上正则。其上 $X_u\times X_v=R\sin u\,X$，故有序叉积法向正是外法向 $\boldsymbol N=X/R$。直接求导得 $E=R^2$、$F=0$、$G=R^2\sin^2u$，以及 $e=-R$、$f=0$、$g=-R\sin^2u$。因此对所有 $q\in\Omega$ 及 $w,z\in T_qX$，$\mathrm{II}_{X,\boldsymbol N}(q;w,z)=-(1/R)\mathrm I_X(q;w,z)$。等价地，在曲面记号下 $d\boldsymbol N(w)=w/R$，再次确认负号。两极被参数域排除，并非球面的奇点。
